source_name: Ethiopian Customs Commission / Ministry of Transport & Logistics
observation: Direct official reporting confirms unprecedented EV adoption surge. High penetration of BYD Seagull, BYD Yuan Up, and Changan Benben in urban passenger fleets.
Limitation Note: HS 8708.30 aggregates all vehicle brakes. China is the origin of >68% of imported brake components into Ethiopia.
Limitation Note: Code covers both heavy commercial trucks and light passenger vehicles. Import growth from China increased 34% YoY following EV deployment.
Limitation Note: Broadest automotive parts tariff code. Directly correlates with the body shop repair backlogs observed in Saris and Lideta.
Limitation Note: Code includes aftermarket auxiliary lights, LED bulbs, and OEM assemblies across all transport types.
Low technical barrier to import; multiple wholesale importers (e.g. SARA General Import) stock universal wiper refills.
Limitation Note: Code covers HVAC air filters, industrial air scrubbers, and automotive filters combined.
Limitation Note: Customs valuation often struggles with modern electronic sensor side mirrors vs basic mechanical mirrors.
